group.description: Action bumps are cosmetic and are all validated by the same two workflows.

packageRules.description: The base image is pinned tag plus digest. libmicrohttpd and cJSON come from that distribution, so an update here is a library update, not a cosmetic one.

The engine pin sits on a branch of a fork that carries a normalizer bounds fix upstream has not merged. A bump to upstream main would remove it. Enable gitSubmodules again once the pin is back on the upstream URL.
